hero.eyebrow: A workspace for documents that matter
hero.title: Every contract, invoice, and reminder, kept in one quiet place.
hero.subtitle: DocVault reads what you upload, surfaces what is expiring, and answers in plain language. Bilingual by default, tenant-scoped by design.
hero.trust: Trusted by accounting, legal, and operations teams across the Gulf.

features.title: Built for the documents you actually keep
features.subtitle: Not a generic storage drive. DocVault is shaped by the way critical paperwork moves through a real office.

ocr.title: Reads Arabic and English
ocr.body: OCR handles both scripts, with side-by-side confidence markers so you know when to double-check.

dates.title: Pulls dates from the page
dates.body: Expiry, renewal, and grace periods are extracted as the document is processed. No manual tagging.

reminders.title: Reminds you before it is late
reminders.body: Set thresholds per document type. DocVault nudges you 30, 7, and 1 day ahead.

search.title: Searches across the archive
search.body: Find a clause, a number, a name. Bilingual search treats Arabic and English as the same document.

chat.title: Talks back, with citations
chat.body: Ask a question about a document. The answer points to the page and the line.

tenancy.title: Keeps work in your workspace
tenancy.body: Tenant-scoped storage. Members see only what they have been invited to.

howItWorks.title: Three steps, then it runs itself
howItWorks.subtitle: The first document takes two minutes. The rest happen quietly in the background.

upload.label: Step 01
upload.title: Upload or scan
upload.body: Drag in a PDF, a photo, or a DOCX. The pipeline accepts what your phone produces.

process.label: Step 02
process.title: Read and index
process.body: OCR runs in Arabic and English. Dates, names, and amounts are extracted. The original is preserved.

act.label: Step 03
act.title: Search, ask, and never miss a date
act.body: Find the document later by what it contains, not by what you named the file.

testimonials.title: What teams tell us after the first month
testimonials.subtitle: These are paraphrased from onboarding calls. They are not endorsements.

salim.quote: We stopped losing track of commercial registration renewals. The reminders are the part we did not know we needed.
salim.name: Salim Al-Busaidi

mona.quote: My accountant and I work in two languages. The fact that the app treats Arabic and English as the same document is the feature I keep telling people about.

data.question: Where is my data stored?
data.answer: Inside your tenant. DocVault is multi-tenant by design, which means your documents are not shared with other workspaces, and they are not used to train shared models.

languages.question: Which languages are supported?
languages.answer: Arabic and English, end to end. OCR, search, and chat all work in both. More languages are on the roadmap but only ship after they meet the same confidence bar.

trial.question: Is there a trial?
trial.answer: Yes. The first 30 days on any plan are free, with full feature access. No credit card to start.

migrate.question: Can I bring my existing files?
migrate.answer: Yes. Drag a folder into the upload area and DocVault will process it in the background. PDF, JPEG, PNG, TIFF, DOC, and DOCX are all supported.

billing.question: How does billing work?
billing.answer: Plans are billed in Omani Rial. Monthly or yearly. We send one consolidated invoice for the workspace.

support.question: How do I reach a person?
support.answer: Email us at the address in the footer. We respond within one business day, and faster on the Practice and Office plans.

footer.tagline: A quiet workspace for the documents that matter. Built bilingual from day one.
